summary.x2_background: runs separately with real TTL elapse

results.name: Identity binding (LIVE)
results.procedure: two separate-process participants bind mailboxes on the deployed service; server-persisted bindings looked up and recomputed
results.evidence: alpha fp=dbb4eeb43b351f14, beta fp=9da69dc11bbba765, persisted and readable via public lookup, fingerprints recompute correctly
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Successful messaging (LIVE)
results.procedure: send worker (separate process) encrypts+signs; fetch worker (separate process) retrieves from deployed service, verifies sender against discovery binding, decrypts
results.evidence: server accept 200 (message_id msg-dbb4eeb43b351f14-1791942694079-b2077c8e); beta fetched count=1; sender_verified=True; byte-exact match
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: same-operator two-instance exchange; NOT independent organizational participation

results.name: Confidentiality (LIVE)
results.procedure: deployed-service ciphertexts fetched by the legitimate recipient; two unauthorized third instances attempt decryption
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: sealed box: no forward secrecy, metadata visible to host

results.name: Impersonation (LIVE)
results.procedure: (1) fresh key claims beta's alias on the live service (2) attacker signs a bind claiming beta's identity key
results.evidence: alias claim -> 403 ALIAS_BOUND_TO_OTHER_KEY; forged key claim -> 401 BINDING_SIGNATURE_INVALID
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Tampering (LIVE)
results.procedure: (1) ciphertext altered after signing (2) envelope message_id altered, signature unchanged
results.evidence: altered ct -> 400 CIPHERTEXT_HASH_MISMATCH; altered envelope -> 401 MESSAGE_SIGNATURE_INVALID
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Authorization (LIVE)
results.procedure: third instance gets a live challenge for beta's mailbox and signs correctly with its own key
results.evidence: own valid key, wrong identity -> 403 KEY_NOT_BOUND
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Replay and duplication (LIVE)
results.procedure: duplicate message_id resubmission; fetch challenge used twice on the live service
results.evidence: dup msg -> 409 DUPLICATE_MESSAGE_ID; first fetch 200, reuse -> 401 CHALLENGE_ALREADY_USED
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Key rotation (LIVE)
results.procedure: dual-signed rotation on the deployed service; sends attempted with old and new keys
results.evidence: rotate 200; old key -> 403 SENDER_NOT_BOUND; new key -> 200
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: rotation requires old key: no silent transfer; clone-key boundary unchanged

results.name: Independent operation (LIVE)
results.procedure: sender process exits after send; a separate recipient process retrieves from the deployed service and verifies offline against the discovery binding
results.evidence: sender process terminated; beta verified=True, decrypted byte-exact=True
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: retrieval depends on the hosted service; verification itself is offline

results.name: Public/private separation (LIVE surface)
results.procedure: public lookup responses and fetched envelopes scanned for plaintext and key material; stored-record scan performed separately via the entity API
results.evidence: leaks on public surfaces: none; fetched payloads are ciphertext + public binding metadata only
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: stored-record scan done via entity read and reported in the evidence report

results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Reused fetch challenge (LIVE)
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Altered recipient identity (LIVE)
results.procedure: validly-signed envelope addressed to HB's mailbox claiming attacker1's fingerprint
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

results.name: Revoked binding (LIVE)
results.procedure: live mailbox revoked by its identity key; inbound, outbound, and owner fetch attempted after
results.evidence: revoke 200; inbound -> 403 RECIPIENT_MAILBOX_NOT_ACTIVE; outbound -> 403 SENDER_MAILBOX_NOT_ACTIVE; owner fetch 200
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)
results.limitations: revocation is NOT fingerprint-wide key retirement

results.name: Encryption-key substitution (LIVE)
results.procedure: (1) attacker rotation on HB's mailbox (2) attacker bind claiming HB's alias+key with attacker X25519
results.environment: deployed Base44 service (lanternMailbox at vesper-f402303b), entity-backed persistence, real server clock, participants in separate processes with independent Ed25519+X25519 keys, ONE operator sandbox (Tier 1)

environment_note: All tests ran against the DEPLOYED lanternMailbox function with entity-backed persistence, real server clock. Participants = separate processes, independently generated keys. ONE operator sandbox: Tier-1 same-operator evidence, NOT independent organizational participation. X2 expired-challenge test runs separately with a real 600 s TTL elapse.
